theorem typeII_639 {α x Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q) (hx : 0 < x) {U V : ℕ}
    (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : (2000000 : ℝ) ≤ V) (hVU : (V : ℝ) ≤ x / U) :
    ‖typeII α x U V‖ ≤
      4 * (√(kap1 x U V) * (√(x ^ 2 / (8 * q) + q * x) * (2 / 3 *
        (Real.log (x / U) * √(Real.log (x / U)) - Real.log V * √(Real.log V))) +
        √2 * x * (√(Real.log V) + 1 / √(Real.log V)) / √V +
        √x * √(Real.log (x / U)) * √(x / U))) +
      8 * 1.4262 * x * √(kap1 x U V * (1 / 2 + 1 / U)) / √V :=

note: Lean needs no lower bound on q and assumes V ≥ 2·10⁶ as the chapter does. It has √2κ₂x(√log V + 1/√log V)/√V in place of κ₂√(2 log x/U)x/√V and 8·1.4262x√(κ₁(½+1/U))/√V for κ₉x/√V; the Δ-term is unsplit and at most the book's.
